svg.title: IBM Concert in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for IBM Concert: six modules; a free 30-day trial with all of Concert's features and no credit card; a 20,000 Resource Unit annual base in the Essentials plan. Each figure is IBM's, from its IBM Concert page and its Concert pricing page. IBM states no test conditions for them.
